d:
Rahul Gandhi has once again raised allegations of vote theft, this time at an event at the University of Chicago in the US. He claimed he had suspicions about electoral irregularities during the 2014 Lok Sabha elections and later found evidence, but senior Congress leaders advised him not to speak publicly. He also explained why the opposition will not boycott elections despite alleged irregularities. What exactly did Rahul Gandhi say? How has the BJP responded?
Video Editor: Mann
